candidates.excerpt: The commerce minister’s statement comes as India and the EU prepare to sign a proposed free trade agreement by the end of the calendar year.

candidates.title: Revanth plans additional water supply for Dindi, Achampet projects
candidates.excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy has directed officials to plan additional water supplies for the Dindi and Achampet irrigation schemes without affecting Palamuru project allocations. He also ordered preparations for talks with Maharashtra on the proposed Tummidihatti barrage.
